key.name: pause-on-unplug
key.summary: Pause when the headphones come off
key.description: When the headphones or a headset in use are unplugged or go away, every player that is playing pauses, so that nothing plays out loud from the speakers. A notice offers to play on.

key.name: clear-voice
key.description: The microphone through PipeWire's own echo cancel and noise suppression, as an input of its own made the one in use. It works only while an app records. Change it with ame desktop clear-voice, which starts and stops it.

key.name: sound-presets
key.description: The output menu offers a preset per output: Flat, Laptop, Speech or Bass, as PipeWire's own equaliser before that output.

key.name: presets
key.description: By the output's node name: laptop, speech or bass. An output that is not named is Flat. Written by ame desktop sound-preset.
